families.name: Incorrect incident title for service request

patterns.text: Resolution: Reclassified the ticket as a service request, then provisioned the requested shared mailbox and distribution list with the correct access permissions.
Resolution: Set up the shared mailbox and DL as requested, granted the team the necessary send/access rights, and confirmed visibility in Outlook.
Resolution: Adapter was rejecting allocations due to an incomplete broker account setup. Corrected the setup, reprocessed the batch, and validated matching status for all affected trades.
Resolution: Found a missing broker SSI mapping causing allocation rejections. Added the mapping, replayed the rejected messages, and confirmed the trades matched successfully.
Resolution: Diagnosed a timeout on the position sync job caused by a locked staging table; cleared the session and reran the sync, confirming holdings matched afterward.
Resolution: Replication job had stalled due to a temporary database lock. Cleared the lock, restarted the job from its last checkpoint, and reconciled positions against downstream reporting.
Resolution: Several events were missing option code mappings after ingestion. Updated the mapping table, reprocessed the feed, and confirmed elections displayed correctly.
Resolution: Root cause was an incomplete option-code mapping for a batch of events; corrected the mapping and reprocessed, verifying elections appeared on the dashboard.
Resolution: Reviewed the settlement message queue, cleared several stuck acknowledgements, and replayed the pending confirmations so custody statuses synced back to the dashboard.
Resolution: Root cause was a stalled consumer on the settlement queue. Restarted the listener, replayed the backlog, and confirmed downstream custody records caught up.
Resolution: Custodian was late sending status updates; paused automated fail-chasing while we waited, then matched statements and reconciled the backlog once messages came through.
Resolution: Submission was rejected due to missing classification data on new entity records. Updated the master data, regenerated the file, and resubmitted successfully.
Resolution: Traced the gateway rejection to incomplete counterparty classification; corrected the records, regenerated the submission, and confirmed acceptance.

Resolution: Traced the defect to a template rendering condition that evaluated incorrectly in production. Corrected the template logic, reran the affected batch, and spot-checked output PDFs before release.
Resolution: The fee section was suppressed by a broken conditional in the report template; fixed the condition, regenerated the client batch, and confirmed the fee table now renders correctly.
Resolution: Diagnosed a broken broker routing link after the account switch; updated the routing table and confirmed subsequent orders flowed through without manual intervention.
Resolution: A stale clearing account mapping from a recent broker change was blocking order routing. Corrected the mapping, tested with one order, then released the remaining held orders.
Resolution: Reviewed the request with the tax team lead, granted the standard processing entitlement, and verified access to the output workspace.
Resolution: Confirmed the withholding tax workflow license was provisioned and validated the user could access the quarterly extract tool.
Resolution: Reconciled the cash ledger against the bank statement and found the sweep missed the prior day's cutoff; booked a value-dated adjustment and confirmed the balance with the desk.
Resolution: Traced the shortfall to a missed banking cutoff on the margin sweep; corrected with an intraday adjustment and confirmed with Treasury.

input.Summary: New license requested for quarterly withholding tax workflow
input.Description: The operations team needs one additional user license to support the quarterly withholding tax filing workflow for the Germany entity. The requester selected a reporting-related service, but the detailed business need is to prepare and review tax output rather than regulatory submissions.
All Comments: amelia.marcus@intcom.com: Request is for the colleague who prepares withholding tax extracts and validates the generated tax packs.

precedent.text: Resolution: Confirmed the withholding tax workflow license was provisioned and validated the user could access the quarterly extract tool.

input.Summary: Access requested for Portfolio Accounting to support month-end reconciliation
input.Description: A new operations joiner needs standard Portfolio Accounting access to support month-end reconciliation and exception review. The requester confirmed that the employee only needs the normal processing role and read access to the reconciliation dashboards.
All Comments: maia.berg@intcom.com: Standard processing access required for month-end reconciliation support.

input.Summary: New license requested for sanctions screening dashboard
input.Description: A new compliance analyst needs a standard license for the sanctions screening dashboard used in daily control activities. The request concerns monitoring of rule exceptions and periodic review of escalated alerts rather than document management or collaboration.
All Comments: maia.berg@intcom.com: Standard compliance analyst license requested for sanctions screening dashboard.

input.Summary: Custodian notice says MT536 settlement status messages are delayed for France books
input.Description: A custodian notice reports delayed MT536 settlement status messages for several France books. The trades themselves are already matched, but final custody settlement updates are not arriving on time. The selected service in the intake reflects an upstream processing guess rather than the stage where the issue actually occurs.
All Comments: info@extcom_08.com: MT536 settlement status messages delayed for several France books. Next vendor update expected soon.
service.desk@intcom.com: Vendor notice copied into Jira. Functional owner still unknown.

precedent.text: Resolution: Custodian was late sending status updates; paused automated fail-chasing while we waited, then matched statements and reconciled the backlog once messages came through.

input.Summary: Trade matching adapter TMA-402 rejected 16 allocations from broker JPM
input.Description: The TMA-402 trade matching adapter rejected 16 allocation messages from broker JPM because the inbound execution references could not be paired with the staged allocations in time. The affected trades are booked, but the confirmation workflow is blocked until the matching backlog is cleared.
All Comments: sa_securities@intcom.com: Adapter TMA-402 rejected 16 allocation messages for broker JPM. Matching state remains pending.
monitoring.bot@intcom.com: Automated incident created from matching adapter error threshold.

precedent.text: Resolution: Adapter was rejecting allocations due to an incomplete broker account setup. Corrected the setup, reprocessed the batch, and validated matching status for all affected trades.

input.Summary: Client report PDFs for the Nordics entity were generated with a blank fee section
input.Description: The client reporting team observed that the latest batch of Nordics quarterly client report PDFs was generated with a blank management fee section, even though the staging preview displayed the values correctly. Users can still open the reports, but the distributed output is incomplete and unsuitable for release.
All Comments: nadia.morgan@intcom.com: Preview looked correct, but the generated PDF pack for Nordics dropped the management fee block on every report tested.

precedent.text: Resolution: The fee section was suppressed by a broken conditional in the report template; fixed the condition, regenerated the client batch, and confirmed the fee table now renders correctly.

input.Summary: Cash not there pls fix asap for yesterday margin sweep
input.Description: The reporter entered a short and unclear message saying that cash was missing after a margin sweep. While the wording is poor, the business language points to a treasury or liquidity movement issue rather than a general platform defect. Triage is needed to clarify the exact account and booking date.
All Comments: helen.smith@intcom.com: Margin cash looked wrong after yesterday close. Need help quickly.

precedent.text: Resolution: Traced the shortfall to a missed banking cutoff on the margin sweep; corrected with an intraday adjustment and confirmed with Treasury.

input.Summary: Rimes overnight benchmark file DM_RIMES_FU_PR_BBG3_EODD_20260918_1.txt arrived after the downstream cutoff
input.Description: Rimes Client Managed Services reported that the benchmark file DM_RIMES_FU_PR_BBG3_EODD_20260918_1.txt was delivered after the agreed processing window. The price mastering job for the Germany book therefore started with stale input and the downstream valuation chain is at risk. The case was logged quickly and the selected service may not match the actual vendor feed problem.
All Comments: info@extcom_11.com: Late feed delivery update for DM_RIMES_FU_PR_BBG3_EODD_20260918_1.txt. Delivery completed after the expected cutoff.
service.desk@intcom.com: Intake created from external vendor mail. Awaiting service triage.

input.Summary: Vendor notice: Americas benchmark publication delayed beyond the publishing window
input.Description: An external vendor warning states that the Americas benchmark publication was delayed and that downstream consumers should expect incomplete price snapshots until the corrected files are posted. The ticket was raised quickly from the mail body and the selected service may reflect the channel rather than the actual impacted platform.
All Comments: info@extcom_15.com: Delayed benchmark publication for Americas universe. Corrected publication ETA later today.
service.desk@intcom.com: Mail copied into Jira. Awaiting functional routing.

input.Summary: Vendor onboarding mail says LEI submission file was rejected by the regulator gateway
input.Description: A vendor onboarding mail was forwarded into Jira and says the latest LEI submission file was rejected by the regulator gateway because a mandatory classification segment was empty. The selected service in the intake does not reflect the actual process described in the message.
All Comments: info@extcom_20.com: Submission file rejected by the regulator gateway. Error text mentions missing classification segment in the LEI submission payload.
service.desk@intcom.com: Forwarded from vendor onboarding mailbox. Service needs confirmation.

precedent.text: Resolution: Submission was rejected due to missing classification data on new entity records. Updated the master data, regenerated the file, and resubmitted successfully.

input.Summary: SimCorp replication job SCD_POS_SYNC failed on host EAPW8504
input.Description: A technical account created an incident after the SimCorp replication job SCD_POS_SYNC failed on host EAPW8504. Position updates were not synchronized to the reporting layer and operations may see stale holdings until the failed replication run is corrected.
All Comments: sa_accounting@intcom.com: Job SCD_POS_SYNC failed on EAPW8504 with replication timeout.
monitoring.bot@intcom.com: Automated incident created because reporting synchronization did not complete.

precedent.text: Resolution: Replication job had stalled due to a temporary database lock. Cleared the lock, restarted the job from its last checkpoint, and reconciled positions against downstream reporting.

input.Summary: NAV_EOD_GE_375 stopped after valuation tolerance breach on 4 funds
input.Description: An automated monitoring rule raised an alert for NAV_EOD_GE_375 after the end-of-day valuation run breached configured tolerance thresholds on several Germany funds. The batch did not publish the NAV snapshot to the downstream control queue and requires triage before the next accounting cycle begins.
All Comments: sa_accounting@intcom.com: Alert source NAV_EOD_GE_375 on host calc-prd-09. Tolerance breach detected.
monitoring.bot@intcom.com: Automated incident created because the downstream NAV publication queue did not receive a success event within 10 minutes.

input.Summary: Compliance monitoring dashboard shows stale breach statuses after yesterday's rule update
input.Description: After yesterday's rule update, the compliance dashboard still shows several breaches as open even though the underlying portfolio checks have already been rerun successfully. Analysts can work around the issue by opening each case manually, but the overview screen is no longer trustworthy and causes repeated escalations.
All Comments: sebastian.eaton@intcom.com: Breach detail pages look current, but the dashboard summary still shows yesterday's open breaches after the rule update.

input.Summary: Access requested for CRM & Client Portal for a new relationship manager in France
input.Description: A new relationship manager joined the France distribution team and needs standard access to the CRM & Client Portal to review investor interactions and document follow-up actions. The line manager approved the request and asked for the usual role-based profile without elevated rights.
All Comments: beatrice.anderson@intcom.com: Starter access request approved by the team lead. Standard sales role only.

input.Summary: Access removal requested for SharePoint & File Storage after contractor offboarding
input.Description: A contractor left the organization and all project document access for SharePoint & File Storage must be removed before the end of the day. The request covers direct site permissions, synchronized folders, and any inherited access via project groups.
All Comments: nadia.morgan@intcom.com: Contractor contract ended today. Please remove all SharePoint access including synced project folders.

input.Summary: Production outage in Outlook & Email for shared mailbox creation
input.Description: The title sounds like an outage, but the user is actually asking for a new shared mailbox and distribution list for a temporary campaign. No disruption was reported. The task is a standard service request that needs the normal approval and provisioning path.
All Comments: cora.russell@intcom.com: Need a shared mailbox and DL before next week. There is no actual mail outage.

precedent.text: Resolution: Reclassified the ticket as a service request, then provisioned the requested shared mailbox and distribution list with the correct access permissions.

input.Summary: Corporate action ingestion CAEV-874 is missing a mandatory option code on 1 events
input.Description: The corporate action ingestion feed CAEV-874 loaded 1 events without a mandatory option code, so the elections could not be published to the downstream operations screen. The event payloads were received, but users cannot process the instructions until the missing option mapping is corrected.
All Comments: sa_securities@intcom.com: CAEV-874 missing option code on 1 events. Publication to operations screen blocked.
monitoring.bot@intcom.com: Automated incident created from corporate action data-quality rule.

precedent.text: Resolution: Several events were missing option code mappings after ingestion. Updated the mapping table, reprocessed the feed, and confirmed elections displayed correctly.

input.Summary: Orders remain in pending approval after broker account switch in OMS
input.Description: After a broker account switch in the order management workflow, newly submitted orders remain in pending approval and do not progress to execution routing. Traders can still create the orders, but the workflow no longer sends them to the configured broker path and manual workaround is required.
All Comments: maia.berg@intcom.com: Reproduced on three new orders after switching the broker account mapping. Orders stay pending approval and never leave OMS.

precedent.text: Resolution: Diagnosed a broken broker routing link after the account switch; updated the routing table and confirmed subsequent orders flowed through without manual intervention.

input.Summary: Settlement confirmation queue SECLINK-7549 backlog exceeded the operational threshold
input.Description: The settlement confirmation queue SECLINK-7549 accumulated 164 unmatched confirmations within fifteen minutes. Matching for already-instructed trades completed, but final settlement acknowledgements were not posted back into the operations dashboard. The queue depth points to a settlement processing issue rather than a front-office booking defect.
All Comments: sa_securities@intcom.com: Monitoring threshold breach on SECLINK-7549. Confirmation queue depth above 161 for 15 minutes.
monitoring.bot@intcom.com: Auto-ticket opened from securities middleware health check.

precedent.text: Resolution: Reviewed the settlement message queue, cleared several stuck acknowledgements, and replayed the pending confirmations so custody statuses synced back to the dashboard.

input.Summary: Need access removed from all deactivated users in portal today
input.Description: The title reads like an urgent incident, but the body asks for routine identity cleanup after a batch of user deactivations. The request is operationally important because inactive accounts must not retain access, and the selected service in intake may not reflect the identity focus of the task.
All Comments: maia.berg@intcom.com: Daily deactivation batch completed. Need confirmation that inactive users no longer retain portal access.
